rust.name: src/tasks.rs:434:31: replace && with || in classify
rust.why: Every candidate in the tests is a `subset` that asserts, so `(subset || asserts) && within` gives the same classes; no overlap candidate, and no candidate without assertions, tells the two apart.

rust.name: src/test_shape.rs:153:50: replace && with || in top_statements
rust.why: With `||`, anonymous `{`/`}` tokens and comments count as statements. Both tests share the braces, and no test has a comment only one of them holds, so containment likely comes out the same.
